_status: Reference notes, read by no code. Model names refreshed 2026-10-31 from https://ollama.com/api/tags (the same on 2026-11-03); the mimo-v2.6 and nemotron-3-ultra facts are from their ollama.com/library pages on 2026-11-03; the privacy and kingdom_integration notes are from 2026-04 and not re-checked. Ollama retires cloud models often, so check /api/tags before relying on a name. Prices: https://ollama.com/pricing (current plans priced per token since 2026-08-31; older subscriptions may keep session/weekly limits); YOUI's copy is OLLAMA_PRICING in youi-web/server.mjs.

endpoint_notes.openai_compat: ollama.com/v1/chat/completions — Bearer OLLAMA_API_KEY; reasoning comes back in message.reasoning; tool_choice is not supported
endpoint_notes.native: ollama.com/api/chat — Bearer OLLAMA_API_KEY; 'thinking' field; think takes true/false or a level the model defines (/api/show thinking.values)
endpoint_notes.local: localhost:11434 needs no key; once signed in ('ollama signin') it forwards '<name>:cloud' or '<name:tag>-cloud' to Ollama Cloud

glm-5.3-flash.notes: Economy tier in adaptive/ (321B, 18B active). think levels low/high/max.

glm-5.3.notes: 753B coding model; 'best open-weights coding model' is Z.ai's own claim.

deepseek-v4.1-flash.notes: YOUI default where a call names no model; standard tier in adaptive/. Off-peak pricing outside 12:00-18:00 UTC on weekdays.

deepseek-v4-pro:0813.notes: Deep reasoning: no thinking / thinking / max thinking.

kimi-k3.notes: Strongest and dearest; pick by name only.

gemma4:31b.notes: Through a local Ollama: gemma4:31b-cloud (gemma4:31b alone is also a local tag).

gpt-oss:20b.notes: Cheapest text model; think levels low/medium/high.

nemotron-3-ultra.notes: The library page header says 256K; its highlights say 1M.

nemotron-3-super.notes: Superseded by nemotron-3-ultra; not listed by YOUI.

beam.notes: Free for a limited time (no end date stated); not a default.

local_models_note: YOUI names no local models of its own (Yu, 2026-11-03: the latest open-weights models on Ollama Cloud instead); a model the local Ollama lists is still used by its exact name.
all_available_models_note: All 25 names /api/tags listed on 2026-10-31. clef:27b is a decision model on /v1/systemone, not a chat model; muse-spark-open carries a restrictive licence.

kingdom_integration.python_tools: Set OLLAMA_API_KEY (or OLLAMA_BASE_URL=http://localhost:11434 for a signed-in local Ollama), import from tools/ollama-cloud.py
